messages:
Evan: RCA published for 2026-04-02 partial routing outage. Link: <https://docs.redwood.com/rca/2451|RCA: routing policy regression>. Impact: ~12m window, increased 5xxs for ~2% of traffic.

Evan: Short owner list and asks below — please confirm ETA and blockers.

Owners:
- Revert risky routing change + add test coverage (Maya) — roll by 2026-04-05.
- Add a synthetic check for routing policy violations (Sam) — alert + dashboard by 2026-04-06.
- Run replay with mixed-model traffic to validate (eng-sre / Evan) — run by 2026-04-08.

Maya: Taking revert + tests. Will open PR today and include unit + integration tests.

Sam: Will add synthetic check. Propose threshold at 0.5% routing deviation. Posting spec in #eng-platform.

ops-bot: Incident INC-35012 created and linked to RCA 2451; owners: Maya, Sam, Evan.

Renee: Can someone draft a 2-line exec note for ELT? Need before EOD.

Evan: Exec note: "On 2026-04-02 a routing policy regression briefly diverted a small subset of traffic causing elevated errors. No customer data was affected. We reverted the change, added tests, and are adding monitoring; fixes complete by 2026-04-08."

Maya: LGTM.

Sam: I'll post dashboard link when ready.

Evan: Thanks — please update INC-35012 with PRs and canary results. Weekly checkpoint scheduled 2026-04-07 09:00 PT.
